snippet.title: Dracamar - Release Date Announcement Trailer - Out March 26 on PC, PS5, PS4, Xbox One/Series
snippet.description:
Dracamar will release this March 26 on PC, PS5, PS4, Xbox One/Series 
Wishlist on Steam: https://bit.ly/dracamar_steam
Site: https://bit.ly/dracamar_cat

Welcome to the world of Dracamar!
Embark on a 3D platformer adventure and fight King Crad, the evil dragon who wants to conquer the world of Dracamar. Run, jump, and battle to rescue the magical Okis.

Join Caliu, Foc, and Espurna on a journey full of adventures in the magical island world of Dracamar. 

Collect all the Moki-balls to rebuild the bridges and reconnect the islands. Get ready to fight the evil King Crad and save the world with your friends!

Follow Dracamar: 
* X: https://bit.ly/dracamar_x
* Facebook: https://bit.ly/dracamar_facebook
* Instagram: https://bit.ly/dracamar_instagram
* Tiktok: https://bit.ly/dracamar_tiktok
* Bluesky: https://bit.ly/dracamar_bluesky
